description:
Miami Lakes Educational Center is a vocational-technical training center in Miami Lakes. Its campus went through multi-phase upgrades and renovations.

Work included exterior stucco repairs and painting, a new covered walkway at the bus drop-off zone, flooring replacements in the auditorium and general areas, upgraded fire alarm and security networks, and new classroom space.
